messages.Scouts have strength 1 and cannot defeat: Scouts have strength 1 and cannot defeat another Scout. Choose Soldier in Recruit, then click your Scout. Pay the 10-gold difference for strength 2 and wages of 12 per turn.
messages.Seed must be a number between 0 and 2147: Seed must be a number between 0 and 2147483647.
messages.Select an event, then paint. Every encou: Select an event, then paint. Every encounter resolves on the first visit.
messages.Select either ready Scout and capture an: Select either ready Scout and capture another empty neutral province. Keep alternating useful captures with End turn when your armies are spent. Hover over gold whenever you need to check the resulting budget.
messages.Select either western Scout and capture: Select either western Scout and capture the marked neutral gap. This joins the two regions into one kingdom and pools the remaining gold. Reconnection can rescue land that could not support itself.
messages.Select the new Scout and capture another: Select the new Scout and capture another empty neutral province. Each army normally gets one action per turn; both Scouts will then have acted.
messages.Select your Scout and capture this neutr: Select your Scout and capture this neutral source. Sources increase maximum mana; every four controlled sources also add regeneration. Trailblaze leaves the Scout ready, so you can immediately use the new foothold.
messages.Select your Scout and click the marked n: Select your Scout and click the marked neutral shore, beyond the Bridge. Crossing friendly land and empty bridges is part of the same move. When the landing is reachable, avoid wasting a turn stopping on the Bridge.
messages.Select your Soldier and attack the marke: Select your Soldier and attack the marked Scout. An attack normally needs higher strength than the province's defense. Armies lend up to strength 2 to adjacent land of the same owner; they do not protect enemy or neutral land.
Set computer difficulty for every seat.
messages.Set the value of existing land, from 1 t: Set the value of existing land, from 1 to 6. Keeps ownership and objects.
messages.Shatter costs 2 mana. End turn to regene: Shatter costs 2 mana. End turn to regenerate enough. Its targets are reachable neutral structures; it cannot erase an enemy-owned Tower or an impassable mountain.

messages.Take the marked capital. Adjacent provin: Take the marked capital. Adjacent provinces in that kingdom surrender too. Their buildings remain, so the Tower becomes yours without paying to build one or destroying it in a direct attack.

messages.The %s kingdom declares independence. It: The %s kingdom declares independence. Its constitution is mostly pitchforks.
messages.The Soldier is defeated, but your Knight: The Soldier is defeated, but your Knight has spent its action. End turn before attacking the nearby Tower.
messages.The Soldier now borders your lower provi: The Soldier now borders your lower province, two steps from the Tower. End turn to see it capture that uncovered land. Coverage and approach routes matter more than simply owning a Tower.
messages.The Steam connection failed. The online: The Steam connection failed. The online match has ended.
messages.The Tower protects adjacent ENEMY land,: The Tower protects adjacent ENEMY land, including its capital. It does not protect the neutral land or your provinces. The Scout above it lies outside its coverage and offers a weaker approach.
The altar awakens: a new mana source.
The army belongs to a connected kingdom.
messages.The border is corrected. Several provinc: The border is corrected. Several provinces were apparently a clerical error.
messages.The cave has a clear exit beside your bo: The cave has a clear exit beside your border House. End turn to see it spawn a Bear. A newly emerged animal does not also move that turn, giving you time to recognize the threat.
messages.The connection could not keep up with th: The connection could not keep up with the match.
The current game will be discarded.
messages.The drink lives up to its name. Your arm: The drink lives up to its name. Your army does not.
messages.The enemy Knight can still defeat a Sold: The enemy Knight can still defeat a Soldier. Click the Soldier's ground and choose Entrench. This spends the action to absorb one attack on this province. It can buy time when a stronger army threatens a position you need to hold.
messages.The enemy Knight threatens the forward S: The enemy Knight threatens the forward Scout. Move your rear Scout onto it to merge into a ready Soldier. Merging costs no gold, but wages rise from 8 for two Scouts to 12 for the Soldier.
messages.The enemy Soldier can capture your expos: The enemy Soldier can capture your exposed border capital next turn. Click the marked rear province and choose Move capital. Confirm the 10-gold price. Relocation protects the treasury; later moves cost more. Cancelling spends nothing.
messages.The event library changed. Start a new S: The event library changed. Start a new Steam lobby to use the updated events.
messages.The family pays 20 gold. No receipt is r: The family pays 20 gold. No receipt is requested.
messages.The ground gives way. A hidden pit swall: The ground gives way. A hidden pit swallows your army before anyone can throw down a rope.
messages.The host left. Return to multiplayer to: The host left. Return to multiplayer to start a new lobby.
messages.The innkeeper insists your army try the: The innkeeper insists your army try the local spirits. Declining would insult his hospitality, his ancestors, and the large man blocking the door.
messages.The marked chest pays 15 gold when captu: The marked chest pays 15 gold when captured. Move your Scout onto it. Immediate loot can fund another purchase this turn, while ordinary province income arrives on later turns.
messages.The marked connection supports three Sol: The marked connection supports three Soldiers in the lower pocket. Use your Knight to take it. The pocket is large enough to form a new kingdom, but its poor land cannot pay 36 gold of wages.
messages.The marked province is the exposed Scout: The marked province is the exposed Scout's only connection to its treasury. Take it with your Soldier. A single isolated province has no kingdom bank to pay its army.
messages.The marshal reports that our army is per: The marshal reports that our army is perfectly balanced, provided one ignores its composition, deployment, and continued existence. He proposes a fresh start.
messages.The next unit you move can move again if: The next unit you move can move again if it captures neutral land. Any valid move consumes this effect. Persists until used.
messages.The opponent took your last capital. Ret: The opponent took your last capital. Retry this exercise to try a different opening. Expand into useful land, keep your armies paid, and reinforce where they can act.
messages.The peasants have formed a representativ: The peasants have formed a representative assembly. Every representative carries a pitchfork, and their first motion is that we should leave immediately.
messages.The priests predict disaster. The treasu: The priests predict disaster. The treasurer predicts revenue. The recruiting sergeant proposes recruiting volunteers inspired by the omen.
messages.The royal forester has spent three month: The royal forester has spent three months counting trees. A man with an axe offers to conclude the investigation before lunch.
messages.The same Scout is still ready. Capture a: The same Scout is still ready. Capture another highlighted neutral province without ending the turn. This is how a small mana investment can turn into more land and recurring income during ordinary expansion.
messages.The treasury is empty. The peasants have: The treasury is empty. The peasants have discovered fiscal policy.
messages.The upgrade did not give your army anoth: The upgrade did not give your army another action. Click End turn to ready the Knight before its next attack.
messages.This capital has defense 2 because of th: This capital has defense 2 because of the neighboring Tower, so your Soldier needs a Knight upgrade. Pay 20 gold. Buying the rank does not restore its spent action.
messages.This connected kingdom has trees. Reward: This connected kingdom has trees. Rewards depend on how much potential income they block.
messages.This crossing could let either side appr: This crossing could let either side approach. Destroying a bridge removes the route, and any army standing on it is lost. Check what depends on the crossing before spending mana to cut it.
messages.This encounter offers an income landmark: This encounter offers an income landmark or a ready Scout with normal wages. Both choices are valid here. Landmarks remain on the province; their benefits depend on keeping control of that land.
messages.This invitation is for a different game: This invitation is for a different game or incompatible version.
messages.This is a normal small match against an: This is a normal small match against an Easy opponent: one Scout, 10 gold, and no prescribed moves. Expand into neutral land, fund the units you need, and take the enemy capital. Buildings and magic are tools, not compulsory purchases. Retry restarts this practice position.
This is not a supported Slay level.
messages.This kingdom earns 39 per turn. A Knight: This kingdom earns 39 per turn. A Knight and Scout cost 40, and savings are empty. You cannot dismiss armies to avoid wages: plan purchases carefully. Ending now would bankrupt this kingdom and kill its supported armies.
messages.This kingdom has four sources, including: This kingdom has four sources, including its capital, for capacity 5 and regeneration 2. Start with 1 mana and end turn: it becomes 3. Regeneration cannot exceed capacity, so unused mana may stop growing.

messages.Use the summoned Scout before ending the: Use the summoned Scout before ending the turn. Summon is useful when another ready army can do something now; creating troops you cannot support just moves the cost into future wages.
messages.Use your cheaper, ready Scout to capture: Use your cheaper, ready Scout to capture ordinary value-1 neutral land. Keep the Knight guarding your border. You do not need a rare rich province or another expensive unit: one extra connected income covers this small shortfall.

messages.Your Soldier survived a stronger attacke: Your Soldier survived a stronger attacker and is ready again. The Knight spent its action, and the shield is gone. Entrenchment buys a turn; it does not make the army permanently stronger.
